notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one permanent card in hand.
Evolution Witness has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Evolution Witness using Psychic Frog's first ability by discarding a permanent card, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
